## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000021, organization SEA, and CASE-021. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

Internal timing comes from qualified electrical-shop window; external timing is conditional on OEM drive-module arrival. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
